text:
Maya Tran: Heads up 1: pulled the post-launch dashboard for the May release and noticed conversions plateau after day 7 at ~1.2% (DAU->MQL). doesn't match our expectation from historical launches :thinking_face:
Evan Cole: saw that in the weekly email. could be real funnel decay or an attribution artefact. which cohort window did you use? :eyes:
Maya Tran: pulseboard uses a 7-day cohort by default, but our lead routing supports a 14-day lookback for partner attributions. so either leads are converting later or UTM mapping changed
Jorge Rivas: paste the SQL you ran and i'll join against leadflow+crm to compare labels
Maya Tran: snippet: ```SELECT cohort_day, count(distinct user_id) as mqls FROM events WHERE event='mql' AND launch_id='may_release' GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day;```
Leah Park: note: we shipped a routing backfill last week that maps some partner partners to `utm_content` instead of `utm_campaign`. that would reshuffle source counts in CRM
Tom B: that backfill explains discrepancies between raw event feed and crm-backed cohorts. pulseboard reads raw events so the dashboard would show the pre-backfill view
Maya Tran: so dashboards vs CRM dashboards could diverge. need to know if users later converted or were just reclassified
ops-bot: System: leadflow-sync to crm-backfill completed at 2026-03-22T09:23:12Z (processed 7.2k records).
Evan Cole: plan: 1) isolate organic (no-UTM) cohort to test real funnel, 2) compare raw vs crm-backfilled cohorts for paid/social channels
Jorge Rivas: running diffs now. will produce two time-series and a CSV export. expecting results in ~15-20m
Leah Park: also check webinar registrants 1: a redirect was stripping queries for some registrants, routing them as `direct` instead of `email_campaign`. that could deflate email-attributed conversions
Maya Tran: good catch. that would move high-intent leads into wrong buckets and lower visible conversion in email cohort
Tom B: we should add a small metadata annotation for routing/backfill changes on pulseboard (timestamp + short note)
Evan Cole: +1. even a simple "last attribution change" field would be helpful for weekly KPI readers
Jorge Rivas: diff results: raw-event cohort shows the day-8 drop; crm-backfilled cohort shows a modest recovery. delta concentrated in paid/social and partner X where backfill reassigned source
Maya Tran: sounds like attribution mapping mainly responsible. next: Leah to pull session-level traces for a sample of affected user_ids to confirm conversion timing
Leah Park: will pull session traces for 200 impacted users and report whether conversions happened after day 7
ops-bot: Calendar: "post-launch signal sanity" meeting scheduled at 2026-03-22T10:10:00Z for 30m. Invited: Maya Tran, Jorge Rivas, Evan Cole, Leah Park
Maya Tran: action items before meeting: Jorge upload CSV diff, Leah session traces, Evan add dashboard annotation + short PM blurb, Tom scope pulseboard metadata toggle
Tom B: will add metadata toggle and a UI option to switch raw vs crm-backed series today (low effort)
Evan Cole: i'll draft the PM note: 2 bullets + link to CSV for execs
Jorge Rivas: CSV uploaded to marketing assets: https://redwood.internal/files/may_launch_attrib_delta.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya Tran: thanks team. long-term ask: add an "attribution parity" check to weekly KPI reports to catch these earlier
Leah Park: and a pre-launch checklist for webinar redirect checks so registrant sources don't get lost
Maya Tran: final for the meeting: land the metadata toggle and prepare a 1-paragraph exec summary with estimated % conversion reclassified. meet in 45
Evan Cole: on it. :thumbsup:
